title: Menu Item
description: A single item in a navigation menu — with an optional link and optional child items.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display text for this menu item.

allOf.title: Link
allOf.description: Where this item goes. Omit for parent-only items.
Optional icon from the design system's icon set, shown alongside the label.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Restrict this item to a single breakpoint. Leave unset to show it at all breakpoints.

showChildCategories.title: Show child categories as child items
showChildCategories.description: List this category's child categories under it, ahead of any child items added here. Needs a product source with a category tree, such as commercetools.
